description: Live events in ZStreet (street.zscan.cash), served by api.zscan.cash/v1/street/events. Weekly events repeat at a UTC weekday and time (the API returns the next or current occurrence); one-off events take start_time (RFC 3339) or start_height. kind: nu7, concert, tournament, race or party. The NU7 activation party is added automatically from the upgrade schedule.
